items.pull_quote: The president of Verve was Jean Philippe Alad, and he is the one that I did ten C.D.s with, so I was very happy about that date.
items.summary: He said Verve's president, Jean-Philippe Allard, was the man with whom he made ten CDs.
items.notes: 'Jean / Philippe Alad' = Jean-Philippe Allard. Sits after q001 in the same turn; no overlap.

items.pull_quote: I played one so loud people could here “Body and Soul” in the streets.
items.summary: He recalled playing his copy of Body and Soul so loud that people could hear it in the street.
items.prompted_by: how he and Liston worked at a distance
items.notes: Extends q020 ('Coleman Hawkins was my idol. … I bought 3 copies and I hid two.'), which ends immediately before this sentence; together they read as one passage. 'could here' is the transcript's typo for 'could hear'.

items.pull_quote: So we went to the Guggenheim museum together and it was 5,000 years of Chinese history. We discovered the mask of the Shang dynasty.
items.summary: He recalled visiting a Guggenheim show of 5,000 years of Chinese history with Min Xiao Fen and finding the mask of the Shang dynasty.
items.notes: 'together' = with Min Xiao Fen, named earlier in b309839. Sits after q023; no overlap.

items.pull_quote: Their instruments are basic instruments we knew as a ginbiri. They call it the hajhouj. Sometimes it’s called a santir. It’s a three-stringed instrument.
items.summary: He named the Gnawa's basic instrument — the ginbiri, hajhouj or santir — a three-stringed instrument.
items.prompted_by: the Spirit: The Power of Music concert
items.notes: Sits between q027 and q028 (q028 begins 'With the instrument they had contact with the creator.'), so the three read as a run. 'ginbiri' = gimbri/guembri; 'santir' = sintir.

items.pull_quote: For me, the continent was swinging before man ever arrived.
items.summary: He said the continent of Africa was swinging before man ever arrived.
items.prompted_by: whether he tried to force a fusion with the Gnawa
items.notes: Completes the thought of q037 ('Africa, for me, it's the center of spirituality … the music describes the continent itself.'), which ends immediately before; and is followed directly by q038 ('Early man had to listen…').

items.pull_quote: There’s no such things as this is old, this is new, certain songs have a particular message, you know?
items.summary: He said there is no old or new in music: certain songs carry a particular message.
items.prompted_by: the live concert in St. Lucia
items.notes: Follows directly on q056 ('…the messages are eternal, nothing changes.').

items.pull_quote: She died; this was 2001. At the same time, I got a contact from people in Japan that they wanted me to play solo piano in the Shinto shrine.
items.summary: He said that when his sister died in 2001 he was at the same time invited to play solo piano in a Shinto shrine in Japan.
items.prompted_by: whether Tamashii was inspired by Japan
items.notes: 'She' = his sister; follows directly on q061 ('I have one sister, no brothers. … very giving.').

items.pull_quote: We organized this festival and I brought over Odetta, Max Roach’s without Max: Cecil Bridgewater, Billy Harper, Junior Booth, my son Azzedine played percussion. We had Ahmed Abdul-Malik, we had Mandrill, and Pucho and His Latin Soul Brothers, and we had 40 African musicians.
items.summary: He listed who came to his 1972 Tangier festival: Odetta, Max Roach's group without Max, his son Azzedine, Ahmed Abdul-Malik, Mandrill, Pucho and His Latin Soul Brothers and 40 African musicians.
items.prompted_by: the spiritual highlights of recent years
items.notes: 'Junior Booth' probably = Juini Booth. Sits after q083 and before q084 ('We had this three-day festival…'); no overlap.

items.pull_quote: I finally went into the shop after two or three trips from New York back to Paris. She saw me, I never saw her.
items.summary: He said he finally went into her shop after two or three trips from New York to Paris; she had seen him, but he had never seen her.
items.prompted_by: how he met and married Fatou
items.notes: Extends q092 ('I passed her shop many times … I'd never come out again.'); a transcriber's '(Laughs)' separates them, so the joined quote starts after it.

items.pull_quote: One day, we were sitting in a hotel, the three of us, and all of the sudden the spirit came and said to me…
items.summary: He said that one day, sitting in a hotel with Fatou and their guide, the spirit suddenly came and spoke to him.
items.prompted_by: how he met and married Fatou
items.notes: Leads straight into q096 ('I told this guy, “I want to marry this woman.” …'), which begins immediately after the ellipsis; the two read as one passage. 'the three of us' = Weston, Fatou and the guide Shadley.
